content: {"praised":["Realistic, gritty cop drama with deep character focus.","Strong ensemble cast, including Michael Cudlitz and Ben McKenzie.","Well-written, well-directed episodes with engaging storylines.","Tough, unvarnished portrayal of police work, similar to The Shield.","Complex characters with emotional depth and moral ambiguity."],"criticized":["Characters lack believability, likability, and realism.","Actors come across as whiney, annoying, loathsome.","Show is too pious, ignoring cop misconduct.","Cops portrayed as stormtroopers, extensions of criminals.","No realistic depiction of cop dynamics, unlike The Wire."]}
